name: high-roller-holdem
description: High Roller Hold'em — VIP Texas Hold'em casino video game and terminal CLI in strictly typed Node.js

scripts.build: node node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync } from 'node:fs'; cpSync('src/gui/public', 'dist/src/gui/public', { recursive: true });"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && REQUIRE_PLAYWRIGHT=1 node --test dist/test/gui-e2e.test.js
